reason: The 188.85 A^3 triclinic cell and Z=1 are strongly supported by indexing all 24 selected low-angle lines (M(20)=133.5), and the submitted layered framework is chemically recognizable. Exact atom-level recovery is not sufficiently established, however: no comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied; all three CIFs retain essentially one idealized parent framework and differ mainly in cation assignment; the free coordinate refinements were nonconverged or produced implausible Ir-O distances and were discarded; and the final ordering search retained multiple nearly degenerate discrete classes, with several top assignments giving identical profile metrics. The submitted P1 symmetry, fixed oxygen coordinates, full occupancies, Mn/Li antisite realization, and Mn/Co/Ir ordering therefore remain materially underdetermined. A further attempt using a validated whole-pattern refinement and explicit comparison of symmetry, disorder/occupancy, coordinate, and distinct ordering alternatives could plausibly improve the candidate set.
